full_judgment: 16. The High Court Division made another fundamental error in drawing an adverse presumption against the appellant after taking into consideration of his conduct that he was away from home for a considerable time after the killing observing that as he did not give any explanation either cross-examining the witnesses or in his statement under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, which exposed his complicity in the murder, and presumed it as corroborative evidence.
